description: step-issuer, smallstep's cert-manager external issuer: StepIssuer and StepClusterIssuer resources sign certificate requests through a step-ca JWK provisioner. Hardened by QuenchWorks as a minimal, nonroot, 0-CVE image, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Hardened internal PKI in one install: step-ca (your own certificate authority) + cert-manager (certificate lifecycle) + step-issuer (cert-manager signs through step-ca) + trust-manager (the CA root distributed to every namespace).
